summary: Iter 38 full backend + frontend verification. Backend pytest: 5/5 PASS on new tests (gear external-link fields stored & echoed by GET/POST/PUT, defaults for regular items, sub-event creation under arbitrary parent appears in /events/{parent}/sub-events and /events?include_sub_events=true, member denied event create, /api/email/upload-image returns /api/files/<path>). Frontend live UI verified as admin and member: F1 hero-cta-anniversary visible at / (root) for logged-in users, navigates to /anniversary, no Countdown banner present on home root; F2a New GearEditor on /gear (admin inline) renders gear-editor-is-external + gear-editor-external-url + gear-editor-name-html, Price input disabled with label 'Price (ignored for external-link items)' when external is checked; F2b external-link gear card renders correctly with 'Visit' pill in place of price and HTML title 'Visit our Shopify Store' (Visit pill found, card same height as siblings); F3 admin sees sub-event-toggle-create + sub-event-create-form on event detail for an arbitrary (non-anniversary) parent event; F4a code-verified (col-card-upload-{idx}, col-card-remove-{idx}, image-block-upload, image-block-remove all present in PageBuilder.jsx); F4b live UI: profile-avatar-upload visible on /profile, em-avatar-upload visible in Admin → Members → Edit; F5 profile-download-row contains both 'Download my brief' + 'Tax letter' buttons, header no longer carries 'Download my brief'.

ui_bugs.issue: /admin → Gear tab still renders the OLD inline gear editor (Admin.jsx ~L1976). It lacks the new External-link checkbox, External URL field, HTML/Rich title textarea, and price gating. Admins editing gear via the Admin console (the most obvious admin path) WILL NOT see Iter-38 fields. The new GearEditor only lives on /gear's inline 'Add item'/'Edit' admin flow (Gear.jsx).

Cover image uploader in the legacy Admin Gear editor uses data-testid='event-cover-upload' (Admin.jsx line 2010) — DUPLICATES the event editor's cover-upload testid (Admin.jsx line 210 + 2010 share the same testid). Causes selector ambiguity in automated tests.

Banner image field still exposes a URL <Input> (placeholder 'https://... or upload below') alongside the Upload button. F4 spec says remove image URL inputs throughout the site (upload-only). Inconsistent with PageBuilder + Avatar + Cover-image which are now upload-only.
ui_bugs.selector: Dialog 'Edit Gear page' → Banner image input

action_items: Either retire Admin.jsx GearAdmin's local editor and redirect /admin Gear tab to use the new GearEditor from Gear.jsx, OR update the local editor to include the same Iter-38 fields (External-link checkbox, External URL input, HTML/Rich title textarea, and disable Price when external is on).
Rename data-testid='event-cover-upload' inside Admin.jsx GearItemEditor (line ~2010) to e.g. 'gear-admin-cover-upload' to avoid clashing with the EventEditor's cover-upload testid.
Remove the URL <Input> from GearPageEditor 'Banner image' so admins can only upload (parity with PageBuilder image block + member avatar + event cover).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: gear_out + GearItemIn/UpdateIn correctly extend with name_html / is_external_link / external_url with sensible defaults; PUT honors partial updates only when value!=None.
Backend: /events listing excludes sub-events by default (parent_event_id $in [None, ''']) and exposes them via /events/{id}/sub-events + ?include_sub_events=true — confirmed via test.

Frontend Gear.jsx: GearCard correctly gates external rendering (is_external_link && external_url) and uses window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') so the Visit pill click is safe. dangerouslySetInnerHTML inside h3 is constrained to admin-supplied HTML and the placeholder text suggests inline tags — acceptable since only admins can write it.
Frontend Profile.jsx: profile-download-row sits directly after TabsList (line 263) — verified live (header contains no Download brief / Tax letter).
Frontend Admin.jsx duplication: Two separate gear editors exist (Admin.jsx GearItemEditor + Gear.jsx GearEditor). DRY violation + Iter-38 only updated Gear.jsx — Admin.jsx Gear tab is stale.
Frontend Admin.jsx event-cover-upload testid collision (lines 210 and 2010 both use same testid for different uploaders).

PageBuilder.jsx column card upload + image block upload correctly POST to /api/email/upload-image and store the returned URL — testids col-card-upload-{idx} + image-block-upload + col-card-remove-{idx} + image-block-remove present and unique.

success_rate.frontend: F1/F2a/F2b/F3/F4a/F4b/F5 all primary flows verified; 3 secondary issues found (legacy Admin Gear editor stale + testid duplicate + GearPageEditor URL input not removed)

seed_data_creation: Tests create+delete TEST_-prefixed gear items and a TEST_-prefixed sub-event; cleanup is inline (delete after assertions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-38 features all work on the /gear admin inline flow; the discrepancy is that /admin → Gear tab uses an older editor (Admin.jsx ~L1907-L2080) which was NOT updated with the new fields. If main agent fixes this by either swapping to GearEditor from Gear.jsx or porting the 3 new fields, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration38_iter38.py (already idempotent) and re-check both /admin → Gear → Edit AND /gear → admin Add item. The backend already supports the fields, so only the frontend GearItemEditor needs updating. Also rename the duplicate event-cover-upload testid (Admin.jsx ~L2010).
rca of the issue: Two parallel gear editor components exist (Admin.jsx GearItemEditor — old, and Gear.jsx GearEditor — new with Iter-38 fields). Iter-38 only updated the newer component, so the legacy editor accessible via /admin → Gear is missing the new fields, and the gear cover-image upload reuses event-cover-upload testid causing selector collisions in tests.
